mapper.select: SELECT wti.id AS instanceId, wti.source_type AS sourceType, wti.source_id AS sourceId, wti.source_code AS sourceCode, wti.status AS status, wti.current_index AS currentIndex, wti.total_steps AS totalSteps, wti.last_error AS lastError, wti.trace_id AS traceId, wti.create_time AS createTime, wti.update_time AS updateTime, wti.create_user_name AS createUserName, wti.start_time AS startTime, wti.finish_time AS finishTime FROM workflow_task_instance wti WHERE wti.id = #{id} AND wti.is_deleted = false

SELECT wtr.instance_id AS instanceId, wtr.id AS stepId, wtr.index AS index, db.name AS nodeName, wtr.class_path AS classPath, wtr.target_service AS targetService, wtr.target_endpoint AS targetEndpoint, wtr.feign_duration_ms AS feignDurationMs, wtr.error_source AS errorSource, wtr.status AS status, wtr.retry_count AS retryCount, wtr.last_error AS lastError, wtr.input_data AS inputData, wtr.output_data AS outputData, wtr.start_time AS startTime, wtr.end_time AS endTime, CASE WHEN wtr.start_time IS NOT NULL AND wtr.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wtr.end_time - wtr.start_time)) * 1000 ELSE NULL END AS durationMs, wtr.remark AS remark FROM workflow_task_record wtr LEFT JOIN dict_basic db ON db.id = wtr.dict_basic_id AND db.is_deleted = false WHERE wtr.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND wtr.is_deleted = false ORDER BY wtr.index ASC
